blocks.text: Neurons impulses lene, bhejne aur process karne ke liye khaas neural raaston (arcs) par chalte hain. Kuch raaston mein chand neurons hote hain; kuch pecheeda jaal hain. Reflex arc sab se saada neural raasta hai; yeh reflex actions, yaani bairooni aur andaruni muharrik ka fauri, khud kaar aur ghair iradi jawab, qaboo karta hai.

items: Hathora ghutne ke neeche patellar tendon par zarb lagata hai; yeh zarb muharrik hai.
Ran ke quadriceps muscle ka receptor ise mehsoos kar ke sensory neuron mein impulse shuru karta hai.
Sensory neuron impulse spinal cord tak le ja kar baghair inter-neuron ke seedha motor neuron ko deta hai.
Motor neuron impulse effector, yaani quadriceps, tak le jata hai jo sukarta hai: ghutne par nichli taang aage jhatka khati hai.

Saath hi sensory neuron spinal cord ke aik inter-neuron ko bhi jagata hai, jo aise madde chhorta hai jo hamstrings ke motor neurons ko rokte hain, to taang seedhi hote waqt hamstrings dheele rehte hain.

blocks.alt: Mure hue ghutne wali taang pehlu se. Hathora (hammer) ghutne ke neeche tendon par lagta hai. Sensory neuron ran ke agle quadriceps muscle ke receptor se spinal cord (kata hua) tak jata hai. Cord ke andar interneuron hai, aur do motor neurons cord se nikalte hain: aik quadriceps ko aur aik ran ke pichle hamstrings muscle ko.

blocks.prompt: Ghutne ka jhatka itna tez kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ka arc bohat chhota hai: sensory neuron spinal cord mein seedha motor neuron se judta hai, beech mein inter-neuron nahi aur dimagh ke faisle ki zaroorat nahi.

items: Reflex arc: khud kaar jawab ka sab se saada raasta. Knee jerk: quadriceps ka receptor, sensory neuron, spinal cord, motor neuron, quadriceps sukarta; inter-neuron hamstrings ko dheela karta.
